summary: Iteration 45: Satellite Chat Bubbles & Attachment Features - All 10 tests PASSED. Both bubbles hidden on /camera page via hiddenPaths check

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 45 verified satellite bubble design and attachment features. Key findings: 1) AI bubble (violet with sparkles and 'IA' badge) docks to LEFT of nav bar. 2) Chat bubble (orange with message icon and unread count) docks to RIGHT of nav bar. 3) Both bubbles sync minimize/expand with nav bar via NavScrollContext. 4) Scroll down 5x triggers minimize - nav becomes 'BRUNO' pill, bubbles shrink. 5) Scroll up 3x triggers expand - all elements return to full size. 6) Both bubbles hidden on /camera page. 7) AI chat window shows 'BRUNO IA' header with action buttons. 8) Chat popup shows 'Mensajes' header with chat list. 9) Chat window has paperclip attach button, input, and mic button. 10) ChatAttachmentMenu drawer has 6 options: Camara, Galeria, Video, Documento, Tarjeta, Sticker. 11) BubbleSelect options have touch-manipulation CSS class. 12) Backend AI chat returns action buttons and cards_context.
